title: Exact scope visibility through the evaluator and typed resource mapping
summary: `visibleTo` composes scope eligibility through `QueryableAssignmentScopeEvaluator::eligibleContexts()` implemented by the module (`Scopes\Internal\Query\ScopeVisibility`), resource→context mapping is typed by `Contracts\Scopes\MapsAssignmentScope` and computed by core `Authorization\Internal\Query\ResourceContextMapping`, `VisibilityScope` is gone, the `granted_to_all` branch no longer tests `instanceof FolderSource`, and `RelationSource` binds only declared queryable aliases.
why: architecture#risks names the exact-query split as the most intricate move: `VisibilityScope` mixes structural mapping, owner checks, bounded materialization and per-record branches. Splitting it lets core own the mapping and guards while the module supplies only an exact narrowing (R1, R13). Hard risks: any case that cannot be expressed exactly must raise `VisibilityNotSupportedException` (reason `scope_query`), never broaden; the 3456-case parity matrix must stay identical; SQL NULL handling stays explicit.

include: New `Contracts\Scopes\MapsAssignmentScope` (Spi(Implement), contracts#scopes) replacing the `method_exists(azguardContextType/azguardContextRelation)` probe; `Scopes\ContextAware` implements it

Split `Authorization\Query\VisibilityScope` → `Authorization\Internal\Query\ResourceContextMapping` (core: mapping, owner tenant checks, join to the resource branch, tenant/OR/AND guards) + `Scopes\Internal\Query\ScopeVisibility` (module: `eligibleContexts()` body using the existing `Scopes\Query\EligibilityBuilder`)

`Scopes\Internal\ScopeEvaluator` implements `QueryableAssignmentScopeEvaluator`; core passes an isolated guarded candidate query over the definition's model (existing `Scopes\Query\{PredicateBuilder,PredicateQuery,QueryGuard}` keep their FQCN until P3) and accepts only where-narrowing on the same model and connection; `false` or missing capability → `VisibilityNotSupportedException('scope_query')`

`Authorization\Visibility`: contribution applies in every context by a neutral property of the contribution value instead of `instanceof FolderSource` (use the existing Kernel representation if one expresses 'every context', e.g. an `AnyAssignmentScope` context; a new Kernel member is an amendment — stop and ask)

`RelationSource` binding (`Sources\PanelSources`, `Panels\PanelRegistry`) is core-internal preparation from the declaration: only declared queryable aliases are bound; a RelationSource on a panel without a declared queryable alias fails compilation (`DefinitionException`); folder-discovered `Scopes/` definitions are no longer bound unless declared (update Formats/scopes-discovery.json deliberately if it pins binding)
i2/I4 entries for PredicateBuilder→EligibilityBuilder and VisibilityScope removed when fixed
Migration lines: models implement MapsAssignmentScope (or use ContextAware); RelationSource needs a declared queryable alias
exclude: D5 read-coordinator consolidation and the other FolderSource branches in ReadAttempt/AuthorityStage (P3)
Relaxing exact-query semantics or approximating unsupported cases
